actions.create_customer.description: Creates a new customer (quiz lead) in Quizell.
actions.create_customer.props.note.descr: An internal note about this customer.
actions.create_customer.props.quiz_id.de: The ID of the quiz this customer responded to. Find it in your Quizell dashboard under the quiz settings URL (e.g. the number at the end of quizell.com/quiz/12345).
actions.create_product.description: Adds a new product to your Quizell product catalog.
actions.create_product.props.compare_at_: The original price to show a discount (e.g. 49.99). Leave empty if there is no sale.
actions.create_product.props.detail_link: The URL to the product page in your online store.
actions.create_product.props.external_id: The product ID from your external system (e.g. Shopify product ID) for syncing.
actions.create_product.props.image.descr: A publicly accessible URL to the product image (e.g. https://example.com/product.jpg).
actions.create_product.props.price.descr: The selling price of the product (e.g. 29.99).
actions.create_product.props.quantity.de: The available quantity for this product.
actions.create_product.props.sku.descrip: Your internal stock keeping unit code for this product.
actions.create_product.props.status.desc: Whether this product is active and visible in quizzes.
actions.create_product.props.tags.descri: Comma-separated tags to categorize this product (e.g. "skincare, moisturizer, sensitive-skin").
actions.create_product.props.title.descr: The name of the product as it will appear in quiz recommendations.
actions.create_product.props.vendor.desc: The brand or vendor name for this product.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.get_customer.description: Retrieves details of a specific customer by their ID.
actions.get_customer.props.customer_id.d: The ID of the customer to retrieve. Use the "List Customers" action to find customer IDs.
actions.list_customers.description: Retrieves a list of customers (quiz leads) from Quizell.
actions.list_customers.props.page.descri: Page number for results. Starts at 1.
actions.list_customers.props.per_page.de: How many customers to return per page. Maximum is 100.
actions.list_customers.props.search.desc: Filter customers by name or email. Leave empty to return all customers.
actions.search_products.description: Searches for products in your Quizell catalog by title or SKU.
actions.search_products.props.page.descr: Page number for results. Starts at 1.
actions.search_products.props.per_page.d: How many products to return per page.
actions.search_products.props.sku.descri: Search by product SKU (stock keeping unit). Leave empty to skip this filter.
actions.search_products.props.title.desc: Search by product name. Leave empty to return all products.
actions.update_customer.description: Updates an existing customer record in Quizell.
actions.update_customer.props.customer_i: The ID of the customer to update. Use the "List Customers" or "Get Customer" actions to find this ID.
actions.update_customer.props.note.descr: An internal note about this customer.
actions.update_customer.props.quiz_id.de: The ID of the quiz associated with this customer.
actions.update_product.description: Updates an existing product in your Quizell product catalog.
actions.update_product.props.compare_at_: The original price to show a discount. Leave empty if there is no sale.
actions.update_product.props.detail_link: The URL to the product page in your online store.
actions.update_product.props.external_id: The product ID from your external system for syncing.
actions.update_product.props.image.descr: A publicly accessible URL to the product image.
actions.update_product.props.price.descr: The selling price of the product (e.g. 29.99).
The ID of the product to update. Use the "Search Products" action to find product IDs.
actions.update_product.props.quantity.de: The available quantity for this product.
actions.update_product.props.sku.descrip: Your internal stock keeping unit code for this product.
actions.update_product.props.status.desc: Whether this product is active and visible in quizzes.
actions.update_product.props.tags.descri: Comma-separated tags to categorize this product (e.g. "skincare, moisturizer").
actions.update_product.props.vendor.desc: The brand or vendor name for this product.
auth.description:
To get your Quizell API token:
1. Log in to your [Quizell](https://quizell.com) account.
2. Go to **Settings** in the left sidebar.
3. Navigate to **API & Integrations**.
4. Copy your API token from there.

Need help? See [Quizell API Docs](https://docs.quizell.com).
